hook.text: Namaste! I'm Dr. Kapil. ... In the next five minutes, you'll unlock three superpowers of your brain: speed, memory and focus. ... And you'll see the change with your own eyes. Let's begin!

check-intro.text: First, let's see where you are today. ... There is no right or wrong here. ... Just relax, and do your natural best.

speed-teach.text: Your eyes usually jump back and forth while reading. ... Now the words will come to your eyes, one at a time. ... Just keep looking at the red letter in the middle.

memory-teach.text: Here is the secret: your brain loves pictures and stories. ... Now we'll link five new words into one funny story. ... See each picture clearly in your mind.

memory-replay.text: Now see the whole story once more in your mind.

focus-intro.text: Sit comfortably. ... Look softly at the glowing dot.

focus-done.text: Beautiful. ... Your mind is calm and sharp.

reveal-up.text: Wow! ... You just saw it yourself.

reveal-kind.text: Great effort! ... In thirty days of practice, this grows step by step.
